newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber weak on Padang, Medan deals.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber weak on Padang, Medan deals.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices remained weak with no deals heard in late Wednesday trade following foreign buying in Medan and Palembang late on Tuesday, dealers said.
Dealers said January/February SIR20 offer prices remained weak at 54.50-55.00 fob in Medan, 54.25-54.75 fob in Surabaya, Padang and Palembang as well as 53.75-54.25 fob in Pontianak and Jambi.
SIR20 fob Padang was last traded at 54.25 cents late on Tuesday, while SIR20 fob Medan was last at 54.50, dealers said.
They said February SIR20 was likely to remain under pressure due to an expected lower demand ahead of year-end.
Latex dealers said high amoniac latex was on offer at 2,230 rupiah/kg fob in Medan for January shipments.
